cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 - <<'PY'
import itertools,time
P=32; nt=4960; nu=65536
# rows each triple false, all others true => T[p] all rows except triples containing p
row_false=[]
for tri in itertools.combinations(range(P),3): row_false.append(tri)
T=[]
for p in range(P):
 b=bytearray((nt+7)//8)
 for i,tri in enumerate(row_false):
  if p not in tri: b[i>>3]|=1<<(i&7)
 T.append(int.from_bytes(b,'little'))
allT=(1<<nt)-1
# U simple all bits except specific maybe each predicate missing unique half pattern
allU=(1<<nu)-1
U=[allU ^ (1<<(p*1000)) for p in range(P)]
rules=[];checks=[0];nodes=[0]
st=time.time()
def rec(start,combo,cov):
 nodes[0]+=1
 if len(combo)>=4:return
 for p in range(start,P):
  nc=cov|T[p];cc=combo+(p,)
  if nc==allT:
   checks[0]+=1
   ok=True;wt=[]
   for q in cc:
    o=0
    for x in cc:
     if x!=q:o|=T[x]
    e=T[q]&allT&~o
    if not e:ok=False;break
    wt.append((e&-e).bit_length()-1)
   if ok:
    uu=0
    for x in cc:uu|=U[x]
    f=allU&~uu
    if f:rules.append((cc,wt,f&-f))
  else:rec(p+1,cc,nc)
rec(0,(),0)
print('time',time.time()-st,'nodes',nodes[0],'checks',checks[0],'rules',len(rules))
PY
